storyTitle: As Regulatory Data Administrator, I want to import EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III restricted substance entries so that the screening engine has current reference data

functional.title: Successfully import a complete Annex III entry with all mandatory and optional fields
preconditions: User is logged in as a Regulatory Data Administrator with import permissions
User is on the Reference Data Management > Import page

A valid structured import file (CSV/XML) containing a complete Annex III entry with substance name, CAS number, EC number, maximum concentration, product type restrictions, and other conditions of use is prepared
The reference database is accessible and operational

steps.action: Click the 'Import Annex III Data' button on the Reference Data Management page
steps.expectedResult: The Annex III import dialog/page opens with file upload area, format selection, and import options visible

steps.action: Select the structured import file containing a single complete Annex III entry (e.g., substance name: 'Hydrogen peroxide', CAS: '7722-84-1', EC: '231-765-0', max concentration: '12%', product type: 'Hair products', conditions: 'Contains hydrogen peroxide')
steps.expectedResult: File is selected and file name is displayed in the upload area

steps.action: Click the 'Upload' or 'Start Import' button
steps.expectedResult: System begins processing the file and displays a progress indicator

steps.action: Wait for the import process to complete
steps.expectedResult: System displays a success message indicating '1 record imported successfully' with zero errors and zero warnings

steps.action: Navigate to the Reference Data > Annex III Substances list and search for 'Hydrogen peroxide'
steps.expectedResult: The imported substance 'Hydrogen peroxide' appears in the list with CAS number '7722-84-1', EC number '231-765-0', max concentration '12%', product type 'Hair products', and conditions 'Contains hydrogen peroxide'

postconditions: The Annex III entry is stored in the reference database with all fields correctly populated
The imported entry is immediately available for the screening engine to use in substance screening
An audit log entry is created recording the import action, user, timestamp, and record count

functional.title: Successfully import multiple Annex III entries in a single batch file
preconditions: User is logged in as a Regulatory Data Administrator
User is on the Reference Data Management > Import page
A valid structured import file containing 50 complete Annex III entries is prepared with unique substance names, CAS numbers, and EC numbers
The reference database is accessible

steps.action: Click the 'Import Annex III Data' button
steps.expectedResult: The Annex III import dialog opens

steps.action: Select the batch import file containing 50 Annex III entries
steps.expectedResult: File is selected and displayed in the upload area with file size shown

steps.action: Click 'Start Import' button
steps.expectedResult: System begins processing and shows progress (e.g., 'Processing record 1 of 50...')

steps.action: Wait for the import to complete
steps.expectedResult: System displays success message: '50 records imported successfully, 0 errors, 0 warnings'

steps.action: Navigate to Reference Data > Annex III Substances list
steps.expectedResult: All 50 newly imported substances are visible in the list and searchable

steps.action: Search for the first and last substance from the import file
steps.expectedResult: Both substances are found with all their restriction conditions correctly stored

postconditions: All 50 Annex III entries are stored in the reference database
All 50 entries are immediately available for screening engine queries
Import summary report is available showing all successfully imported records
Audit trail records the batch import with total record count

functional.title: Verify imported entries are immediately available for screening engine
preconditions: User is logged in as a Regulatory Data Administrator
A valid Annex III import file with substance 'Diaminotoluene' (CAS: '95-80-7') with max concentration '0%' (prohibited in certain product types) is prepared
The screening engine is operational
The substance 'Diaminotoluene' does not currently exist in the reference database

steps.action: Perform a screening query for 'Diaminotoluene' or CAS '95-80-7' against Annex III
steps.expectedResult: No results found - substance is not in the reference database

steps.action: Navigate to Reference Data Management > Import and click 'Import Annex III Data'
steps.expectedResult: Import dialog opens

steps.action: Select and upload the import file containing 'Diaminotoluene' entry
steps.expectedResult: File is uploaded and processed successfully with '1 record imported' confirmation

steps.action: Immediately perform a screening query for 'Diaminotoluene' or CAS '95-80-7' against Annex III
steps.expectedResult: The screening engine returns a match showing 'Diaminotoluene', CAS '95-80-7', with all restriction conditions displayed

steps.action: Verify the screening result includes all restriction details (max concentration, product type restrictions, conditions of use)
steps.expectedResult: All imported restriction data is displayed in the screening result without requiring any cache refresh or system restart

postconditions: The imported substance is confirmed available in real-time for screening
No system restart or manual refresh was required for the data to become available
The screening engine correctly identifies the substance by both name and CAS number

accessibility.title: Verify focus management when import dialog opens and closes
preconditions: User is logged in as a Regulatory Data Administrator

steps.expectedResult: Focus is trapped within the dialog - it does not move to elements behind the dialog

steps.expectedResult: Focus wraps to the last focusable element in the dialog (focus trap is maintained)

steps.expectedResult: Dialog closes and focus returns to the 'Import Annex III Data' button that triggered the dialog

userStoryObject.title: As Regulatory Data Administrator, I want to import EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III restricted substance entries so that the screening engine has current reference data
userStoryObject.description:
Enable import of Annex III restricted substance list entries including substance identity, CAS number, maximum concentration, product type restrictions, and other conditions of use into the system reference database.

Persona: Regulatory Data Administrator

Acceptance Criteria:

- System accepts structured import of Annex III entries with substance name, CAS number, EC number, and restriction conditions
- Import validates mandatory fields and rejects incomplete records with error details
- Successfully imported entries are available for screening immediately
